Fully Funded Sophie Germain Scholarship in France

France

Apply on the official site

Apply now

Application opens on the official site (www.fondation-hadamard.fr). Scholarship Union does not collect applications.

December 11, 2024 · 2 min read · 443 views ·
Scholarship Summary
Deadline
31 January 2025
Study in
France
Providers
The University Of Paris Saclay
Study Level
Masters, PhD
Scholarship Subjects
All Subjects

Applications are now open for the prestigious Sophie Germain Scholarship 2025/26 in France. This fully funded opportunity invites international students from around the globe to pursue their academic dreams in France.

The Sophie Germain Scholarship supports students seeking to pursue a Master’s Degree (M1 or M2) or a PhD program at renowned institutions such as the University of Paris-Saclay and the Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Funded by the Jacques Hadamard Mathematics Foundation, this program offers approximately 50 scholarships for Master’s students.

Key Highlights

  • Eligibility: Open to international students, including those from outside Europe.
  • Visa Requirement: Students from non-European countries must apply for a visa.
  • Additional Opportunities: Don’t forget to check out the France Eiffel Excellence Scholarship, also available for studying in France.

This is your chance to excel in one of the world’s top academic environments. Learn more about the Sophie Germain Scholarship, its benefits, and how to apply below!

Scholarship Benefits

The Sophie Germain Scholarship 2025/26 Covers:

  • €11,000 Annual Stipend
  • University Registration fees.
  • Up to €2,000 for Round Airfare Travel and Visa
  • Housing and Essential items for international students

Subscribe to Blog via Email

Enter your email address to subscribe to this blog and receive notifications of new posts by email.

Scholarship Eligibility

  • The Scholarship is open to all International students.
  • Students from outside Europe can also apply.
  • Applicants must apply in an eligible Master’s Program.
  • Non-European students must apply for the Visa.

Required Documents

  • Personal Information
  • Master’s Program Name
  • Bachelor’s and Master’s Transcripts
  • Academic CV
  • Referee Names and Emails
  • Study Plan (2-page maximum)

Eligible Fields

The scholarship is available for mathematics and applications programs. Below you will see the List of eligible master’s degrees:

  • Master 1 (M1)
    • Analysis Modeling Simulation
    • Applied Algebra
    • Applied Mathematics (ENSTA-Orsay)
    • Applied Mathematics (Evry)
    • Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence
    • Mathematics and Interaction
    • Mathematics and Statistical Learning
    • Program J. Hadamard Mathematics (Orsay)
    • Program J. Hadamard Mathematics (ENS Paris-Saclay)
    • Program J. Hadamard Mathematics (Ecole Polytechnique)
    • Pure Mathematics
  • Master 2 (M2)
    • Analysis Modeling Simulation
    • Analysis Number Theory and Geometry
    • Applied Algebra
    • Data   Science: Health, Insurance, Finance
    • Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence
    • Mathematics and Statistical Learning
    • Mathematics for the Life Sciences
    • Mathematics of Randomness
    • Mathematics – Vision – Learning
    • Program J. Hadamard Mathematics
    • Optimization
    • Quantitative Finance
